name: Confirm appointments with CALL-E and durable recovery

parameters.content:
## Recoverable appointment confirmation

Install @call-e/n8n-nodes-calle >=0.3.0. Select the same CALL-E API credential on both CALL-E nodes. Create an n8n Data Table using the columns in the README and one authorized appointment row. Set its table ID and row ID in Appointment Settings. Start with dry_run=true; review the masked preview, then explicitly set false for a real call.

The row is the recovery record. Never delete or edit its saved original_request_json, idempotency_key, business_event_id, call_id, cached terminal result, or writeback marker. Re-run the same row after an uncertain create response; only the original request/key are replayed. A saved Call ID bypasses creation. A cached terminal result bypasses all CALL-E requests and retries only business writeback. A completed marker bypasses all writes.

The native Wait node checkpoints for 70 seconds; n8n must use persistent database storage. Keep the workflow saved and credentials available during restarts. Stopping n8n does not cancel a telephone call. Execution data and the Data Table contain private business inputs; restrict access and retention. See README for acceptance and limitations.
